subtitle: Official League options and what Xyra does for you.
optionsHint: The same ones in the League Options menu: Xyra just saves you the search.
noClient: Open League to see and change these options.

borderless.title: Borderless
borderless.description: Needed to see Xyra labels over the game.

attackRange.title: Attack range
attackRange.description: Draws how far your basic attacks reach.

minimapTimers.title: Minimap timers
minimapTimers.description: The objective and camp respawn timers built into the game.

turretRange.title: Turret range (vs. AI)
turretRange.description: Riot only draws it in games against bots: it does not show in ARAM, normals or ranked.

flippedMinimap.title: Minimap on the left
flippedMinimap.description: Moves the minimap to the other side of the screen.

minimapScale.title: Minimap size
minimapScale.description: Bigger reads better on large screens.

automaticHint: Turn it on once and Xyra takes care of it.

keepBorderless.title: Keep Borderless
keepBorderless.description: If the game goes back to fullscreen, Xyra sets Borderless again before your next game.

autoImportBuild.title: Import build by itself
autoImportBuild.description: In champion select it sets the runes, summoner spells and item set of the champion you got. It only replaces its own rune page.

closeWindowInGame.title: Close the window while playing
closeWindowInGame.description: When the game starts the window closes and Xyra stays in the tray, using no memory.

autoAccept.title: Accept matches
autoAccept.description: When a match is found, Xyra accepts it for you unless you already accepted or declined it. Riot asked approved apps to drop this feature: use it at your own risk.

acceptDelay.title: Wait before accepting
acceptDelay.description: Gives you time to decline it yourself.

safe: None of this touches the game or plays for you: it only uses the League client.
